purpose: README previews: sped-up, downscaled animated WebP cut from recorded runs. outputs/ is not committed, so regenerate these after the scene or an expert changes.
method: PyAV decodes the MP4 and keeps every `step`-th frame; Pillow resizes it (LANCZOS) and writes a lossy animated WebP (quality 70, method 6), 80 ms per frame, the last frame held 1.5 s, looping. Speed = step x 40 ms / 80 ms.

kitting.webp.source: outputs/kitting_demo_seed7/expert.mp4 (overview with both wrist D405 insets)
kitting.webp.episode: seed 7, 62.8 s, 6/6 parts placed; the shortest seed of outputs/kitting_check_wrist_block

cameras.webp.source: outputs/kitting_demo_seed7/cameras.mp4 (2x2 mosaic of the four policy cameras)

pick_place.webp.source: outputs/expert_wrist_block/expert.mp4 (overview with both wrist D405 insets)
pick_place.webp.episode: 30.0 s, both parts placed; the current pick-and-place reference run
